doc.t: sample time (master: swerve drive-reading time; IMU record end in heading-only mode), Pi monotonic s
doc.x: position in the world frame (m); world = robot pose at the last reset, x forward, y left
doc.theta: heading (rad, CCW +), continuous (not wrapped): IMU heading where available
doc.vx: body-frame velocity forward (m/s), from the wheels
doc.vy: body-frame velocity left (m/s), from the wheels
doc.x_odom: odometry-only position (heading from the wheels), for comparison
doc.omega_imu: yaw rate from the IMU over the same interval (rad/s; NaN if not covered)
doc.imu_ok: 1 if the IMU heading covered this interval (else the wheel heading was used)
doc.odom_ok: 1 if all four wheel readings were valid
doc.imu_lead: IMU coverage end minus t when the sample was fused (s): how far the IMU was ahead
doc.master: 1 = swerve odometry tick, 2 = IMU record (heading-only mode, no swerve data)
doc.reset_id: number of pose resets since the node started: a change means the world frame moved
doc.discontinuities: wheel-travel jumps skipped since the node started (brownout, unflagged rebase): an increase means a tick's motion was dropped, not integrated
